no_adcom_quote.quote: An Advisory Committee was not convened during the review of BLA 761047.

summary: No FDA advisory committee meeting was convened for BLA 761047 (MEPSEVII/vestronidase alfa). The Unified Clinical Review (Section 9) states an Advisory Committee was not convened during the review, and the administrative correspondence records 'No AC meeting.' Because no committee met, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
